text: The purpose of this report is to obtain approval to designate the easterly northbound lane on The West Mall at Sherway Drive for right turns only, buses excepted. It is appropriate to designate an exclusive northbound right turn lane based on the existing lane configuration and pavement markings at this intersection. As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates transit service on The West Mall, City Council approval of this report is required.

City Council on May 22, 23 and 24, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council designate the easterly northbound lane on The West Mall, from Sherway Drive to a point a point 30.5 metres south, for northbound right turns only, buses excepted.
